subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should Browserbase session lifecycle be supported as a first-party browser profile driver now, routed through a generic browser-backend/plugin seam, or documented as unsupported for stateful Sessions API workflows?
rationale: The fix crosses commercial-service integration scope, browser-control security, credential storage, signed URL redaction, config/schema surface, and session lifecycle policy, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Revise the Browserbase driver path
options.body: Accept a first-party Browserbase driver only after route coverage, credential contract, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

options.title: Design the generic backend seam first
options.body: Keep this issue tied to the broader browser backend/plugin API so Browserbase can ship outside core once the registration contract exists.

options.title: Document the limitation
options.body: Stop recommending the static Browserbase setup until maintainers are ready to support Sessions API lifecycle behavior.

recommendation.title: Revise the Browserbase driver path
recommendation.body: Accept a first-party Browserbase driver only after route coverage, credential contract, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the browser plugin boundary and runtime profile surfaces implicated by the product decision.
